posts.title: Toronto’s Hot Veal Sandwich
posts.description: Veal is a delicately-flavored meat, and here it's stacked up against a pile of big flavors. But the overall impression is savory--between the tomatoes, the cheeses, the meats and the mushrooms, this sandwich is an umami bomb, a fistful of flavor. posts.title: Japan’s Honey Toast
posts.description: The juxtaposition of the berries and their juices, the whipped cream and the ice cream, and the crisp cubes of honey-buttered bread reminds me of the way shortbreads soften as they soak up sweetened juices from macerated strawberries. The post Japan’s Honey Toast first appeared on Sandwich Tribunal .
